channel.title: SQE Daily
channel.description: One free SQE1 practice question every day, with a worked answer and the legal source.

item.title: Counter-offers and the rejection of an original offer
item.description:
On Monday Rhys emails Ola offering to sell her his vintage campervan for £18,000, adding: 'This offer is open until Friday.' On Wednesday Ola replies: 'I will pay £16,500 for it.' Rhys replies the same day: 'No, sorry.' On Thursday Ola emails: 'Fine, I accept your offer at £18,000.' Rhys has meanwhile decided to keep the campervan and refuses to sell.
Which of the following best describes the legal position?

item.title: Time limit for serving a claim form within the jurisdiction (CPR 7.5)
item.description:
A solicitor acts for a claimant in a contract claim against a supplier based in Leeds. The court issued the claim form on 10 February 2026. The solicitor intends to serve the claim form on the defendant at its registered office by first class post.
Which of the following correctly states the latest point by which the claimant must act to serve the claim form in time?

item.title: Removing a company director: ordinary resolution and special notice
item.description:
Maya holds 60% of the shares in Fernhill Joinery Ltd, a private company limited by shares that has adopted the model articles without amendment. She wants to remove Tom, one of the company's three directors. Tom has a written service contract with the company that still has two years to run. Maya would prefer to avoid a meeting and asks whether she can simply circulate a written resolution to the shareholders.
Which of the following best describes how Tom can be removed as a director?
